title: Courgette All Green Bush - Plug Plant 2x - Quick to mature - Heavy Cropper
description:
Courgette All Green Bush - Plug Plant 2x - Quick to mature - Heavy Cropper   Courgette 'All Green Bush' Plug Plants - Heavy Cropping, Easy to Grow 

 Reliable, quick-maturing variety. 
 Produces lots of dark green courgettes all summer. 
 Best picked young at about 10cm (4 inches) for top flavour. 
 Tender skins - great for cooking whole. 
 Grows to about 45cm (18 inches) tall and 90cm (35 inches) wide. 
 Ideal for gardens or large containers. 
 How to Grow: 

 Plant in full sun and well-drained soil. 
 Space plants about 90cm (35 inches) apart. 
 Water regularly, especially in dry weather. 
 Pick courgettes often to encourage more fruit. 
 Companion Planting Tip: 
 Grow with Calendula to attract pollinators and boost your crop.
